messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Gpplot2 feature request - no clipping
parts:
Hi,

When adding geom_text notation to a plot, the dimensions of the
text are not accounted for by the scaling mechanisms. This can cause
clipping of text, deleting key information, such as labels.

In base plot this can be avoided by changing the clipping rules for
the viewport - using par(xpd=NA).

In ggplot, this option is not available, although the grid logic
allows it.

I'd like to see an opt(xpd=NULL) or similar to allow clipping of
the plot areas to be disabled.

This feature can also be used to create dramatic graphics where
points or bars extend out and over the titles. To support this, we
should look to the new scale clipping features, plus a viewport
clipping rule.

-Alex
